import builtins
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    The level and message are used exactly as given (no case changes or
    trimming). Output goes to the console only: nothing is written to a
    log file and the file system is not touched.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "server started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] server started\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_returns_none(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    func: Callable[[str, str], object] = log_line
    result = func("DEBUG", "x")
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert result is None


def test_level_not_altered(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk low")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk low\n"


def test_message_not_trimmed(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "  padded  ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO]   padded  \n"


def test_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] \n"


def test_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_brackets_and_unicode(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "[nested] café ✓")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] [nested] café ✓\n"


def test_multiple_calls_each_on_own_line(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("ERROR", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[ERROR] two\n"


def test_single_trailing_newline(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "msg")
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out.endswith("\n")
    assert out.count("\n") == 1


def test_does_not_touch_file_system(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def forbidden_open(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden_open)

    log_line("INFO", "console only")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
